title: Hello, C++
instructions: Every C++ program starts in main. The computer runs the lines inside its { } from top to bottom.
std::cout << "..."; prints the words between the quotes.
Every line that does something ends with a semicolon ;
task: Make the program print exactly:  Hello, C++!
hint:
Use std::cout with the words in quotes:

    std::cout << "Hello, C++!\n";
